DYN:0.name: SUSTN
DYN:0.en: Inspired by Ross Compressor. A classic squishy analog-style compressor that adds long sustain and snap to clean notes. Sustain sets compression depth, Volume sets output.
DYN:0.pt: Inspirado no Ross Compressor. Compressor analógico clássico, com aquele efeito 'esmagado' que dá sustain longo e punch às notas limpas. Sustain define a compressão e Volume o nível de saída.

DYN:1.name: CMP4
DYN:1.en: Inspired by Keeley Compressor. A clean, transparent four-knob compressor for tightening dynamics and adding sustain. Sustain and Attack shape the squeeze, Clipping and Volume set level.
DYN:1.pt: Inspirado no Keeley Compressor. Compressor limpo e transparente de quatro controles, ótimo para uniformizar a dinâmica e ganhar sustain. Sustain e Attack moldam a compressão; Clipping e Volume ajustam o nível.

DYN:3.name: STUDIO
DYN:3.en: A full-featured studio-style compressor with Threshold, Ratio, Attack and Release, plus Tone and a Blend knob for parallel compression. Great for smoothing clean parts.
DYN:3.pt: Compressor completo estilo estúdio, com Threshold, Ratio, Attack e Release, além de Tone e Blend para compressão paralela. Ótimo para suavizar timbres limpos.

DYN:20.name: MINI-B
DYN:20.en: Inspired by MXR M133 Micro Amp. A simple clean boost that pushes your amp harder with a single Gain knob. Use it for solo lifts or to slam a driven amp.
DYN:20.pt: Inspirado no MXR M133 Micro Amp. Booster limpo e simples, com um único knob de Gain para empurrar o amp. Use em solos ou para saturar mais um amp já distorcido.

DYN:26.name: TAPE-B
DYN:26.en: Inspired by Xotic EP Booster. A warm, slightly thick preamp-style boost modeled on a tape-echo preamp. Gain sets the push, +3dB adds extra level and Bright opens the top end.
DYN:26.pt: Inspirado no Xotic EP Booster. Boost estilo pré-amplificador, quente e encorpado, no espírito de um pré de eco de fita. Gain define o empurrão, +3dB soma volume e Bright abre os agudos.

DYN:10.name: CLN-B
DYN:10.en: Inspired by Xotic AC Booster. A clean boost voiced to add chime and sparkle, in the spirit of a British combo. Gain and Volume set the push, Bass and Treble shape the tone.
DYN:10.pt: Inspirado no Xotic AC Booster. Boost limpo com brilho e cristalino, no espírito de um combo britânico. Gain e Volume controlam o empurrão; Bass e Treble moldam o timbre.

DYN:11.name: DRV-B
DYN:11.en: Inspired by Xotic BB Preamp. A boost with a touch of grit that pushes a tube amp into a rich, dynamic overdrive. Gain and Volume set drive and level, Bass and Treble shape it.
DYN:11.pt: Inspirado no Xotic BB Preamp. Boost com um toque de sujeira que leva o amp valvulado a um overdrive rico e dinâmico. Gain e Volume ajustam drive e nível; Bass e Treble dão o timbre.

DYN:12.name: FULL-B
DYN:12.en: Inspired by Xotic RC Booster. A clean, full-range boost that adds level and a bit of bloom without changing your amp's character. Gain and Volume set the lift, Bass and Treble tilt the tone.
DYN:12.pt: Inspirado no Xotic RC Booster. Boost limpo e de faixa cheia que soma volume e corpo sem mudar o caráter do amp. Gain e Volume definem o empurrão; Bass e Treble ajustam o timbre.

DYN:25.name: PRE-B
DYN:25.en: Inspired by Boss FA-1. A transparent preamp and boost with tone shaping. Bass, Treble and Low Cut sculpt the sound, Volume gives a clean level lift.
DYN:25.pt: Inspirado no Boss FA-1. Pré-amplificador e boost transparente com controle de timbre. Bass, Treble e Low Cut esculpem o som; Volume dá um ganho de nível limpo.

DYN:16777216.name: BODY
DYN:16777216.en: Original acoustic-body effect loosely inspired by TC Bodyrez. It adds the woody resonance of an acoustic guitar body to a piezo or electric signal. Shape changes the body character.
DYN:16777216.pt: Efeito original de corpo acústico, vagamente inspirado no TC Bodyrez. Soma a ressonância de madeira de um violão a um sinal de piezo ou guitarra. Shape muda o caráter do corpo.

DYN:16777217.name: AC SIM
DYN:16777217.en: Inspired by Boss AC-2. An acoustic simulator that turns an electric guitar into a convincing flat-top. Body and Top set the resonance and sparkle, Mode picks the voicing.
DYN:16777217.pt: Inspirado no Boss AC-2. Simulador de violão que faz a guitarra soar como um violão de aço. Body e Top ajustam ressonância e brilho, Mode escolhe a voz, Volume o nível.

DYN:27.name: GATE-S
DYN:27.en: Inspired by ISP Decimator. A smooth, effective noise gate for high-gain playing. A single Threshold control sets how much hiss gets cut between notes.
DYN:27.pt: Inspirado no ISP Decimator. Noise gate suave e eficiente para timbres de alto ganho. Um único controle de Threshold define quanto chiado é cortado entre as notas.

DYN:29.name: GATE-STD
DYN:29.en: A simple noise gate that silences hum and hiss when you stop playing. Threshold sets the cut-off, Attack and Release control how fast it opens and closes.
DYN:29.pt: Noise gate simples que silencia ruído e chiado quando você para de tocar. Threshold define o ponto de corte; Attack e Release controlam a velocidade de abrir e fechar.

DYN:33.name: GATE-FAST
DYN:33.en: A flexible noise gate with Ratio and Hold for fine control. Threshold sets the level, Ratio the amount of reduction and Hold keeps it open so note tails do not get chopped.
DYN:33.pt: Noise gate flexível, com Ratio e Hold para ajuste fino. Threshold define o nível, Ratio a redução e Hold mantém aberto para não cortar o final das notas.

FREQ:16777241.name: Step Filter
FREQ:16777241.en: A rhythmic step filter that jumps between four cut-off settings, for sequenced, synth-like patterns. Step 1 to Step 4 set each step, Rate the speed, Sync locks it to tempo.
FREQ:16777241.pt: Filtro em degraus rítmico, que salta entre quatro frequências de corte, para padrões sequenciados de sintetizador. Step 1 a Step 4 definem cada passo, Rate a velocidade e Sync trava no tempo.

FREQ:16777249.name: Clean Octave
FREQ:16777249.en: A clean octaver that adds an octave below and above your note. Great for organ-like and fat bass lines. Low Oct, High Oct and Dry set the mix.
FREQ:16777249.pt: Octaver limpo, que soma uma oitava abaixo e outra acima da nota. Ótimo para timbres de órgão e linhas graves gordas. Low Oct, High Oct e Dry definem a mistura.

FREQ:16777251.name: Dual Pitch
FREQ:16777251.en: A dual pitch shifter with a high voice up to +24 and a low voice down to -24 semitones, for octaves and fixed harmonies. Hi Pitch, Low Pitch, Hi Vol, Low Vol and Dry.
FREQ:16777251.pt: Pitch shifter duplo, com uma voz alta até +24 e uma baixa até -24 semitons, para oitavas e harmonias fixas. Hi Pitch, Low Pitch, Hi Vol, Low Vol e Dry.

FREQ:16777252.name: Pitch Bend
FREQ:16777252.en: A pitch bender for whammy-style dives and rises, best on an expression pedal. Hi Pitch (up to +12) and Low Pitch (down to -12) set the ends, Range the bend, Wet and Dry the mix.
FREQ:16777252.pt: Pitch bend para subidas e mergulhos de afinação, melhor num pedal de expressão. Hi Pitch (até +12) e Low Pitch (até -12) definem os extremos, Range a curva, Wet e Dry a mistura.

FREQ:16777294.name: Smart Harmony
FREQ:16777294.en: An intelligent two-voice harmonizer that follows a key and scale, for twin-guitar lines. Key and Mode pick the scale, Interval 1 and Interval 2 the voices, Smooth the glide, Mix the blend.
FREQ:16777294.pt: Harmonizador inteligente de duas vozes que segue tom e escala, para linhas de guitarras gêmeas. Key e Mode escolhem a escala, Interval 1 e Interval 2 as vozes, Smooth a transição e Mix a mistura.

FREQ:16777301.name: Pedal Shift
FREQ:16777301.en: A monophonic pitch shifter for big jumps and smooth expression-pedal sweeps on single notes. Range picks the interval, Position sweeps to it, Mix blends and Level sets output.
FREQ:16777301.pt: Pitch shifter monofônico para grandes saltos e varreduras suaves com pedal de expressão em notas soltas. Range escolhe o intervalo, Position varre até ele, Mix mistura e Level ajusta a saída.

FREQ:16777263.name: Ring Mod
FREQ:16777263.en: A ring modulator for metallic, bell-like and robotic tones. Freq and Fine (±50) set the carrier pitch, Tone the brightness, Mix the blend with your dry signal.
FREQ:16777263.pt: Modulador em anel para timbres metálicos, de sino e robóticos. Freq e Fine (±50) definem a frequência portadora, Tone o brilho e Mix a mistura com o sinal seco.

FREQ:16777267.name: Power Amp Sat
FREQ:16777267.en: A power-amp saturation stage that adds the warm squash and grit of a cranked output section. Saturation sets the push, High Cut tames the top, Mix and Volume balance it.
FREQ:16777267.pt: Estágio de saturação de amplificador de potência, que dá a compressão quente e o grão de um power amp no talo. Saturation define o empurrão, High Cut doma os agudos, Mix e Volume equilibram.

WAH:83886081.name: VINT-W
WAH:83886081.en: Inspired by Vox V845. A vintage-style wah with a sweet, vocal sweep that suits funk and classic rock. Range and Q shape the sweep, Position moves it, Volume sets level.
WAH:83886081.pt: Inspirado no Vox V845. Wah de estilo vintage com varredura doce e vocal, ótimo para funk e rock clássico. Range e Q moldam a varredura, Position move o pedal e Volume ajusta o nível.

WAH:83886088.name: QUAK-W
WAH:83886088.en: Inspired by Dunlop Cry Baby. The classic rock wah with a sharp, expressive sweep. Range and Q shape the sound, Position is the pedal travel, Volume sets level.
WAH:83886088.pt: Inspirado no Dunlop Cry Baby. O wah clássico do rock, com varredura expressiva e mordente. Range e Q moldam o som, Position é o curso do pedal e Volume ajusta o nível.

WAH:83886090.name: LEAD-W
WAH:83886090.en: Inspired by Dunlop JP95. A modern signature-style wah with a wide, aggressive sweep and a built-in EQ for dialing in the voice. Range, Q and EQ shape it, Position moves it.
WAH:83886090.pt: Inspirado no Dunlop JP95. Wah moderno de assinatura, com varredura ampla e agressiva e EQ embutido para acertar a voz. Range, Q e EQ moldam o timbre; Position move o pedal.

WAH:83886087.name: BASS-W
WAH:83886087.en: Inspired by Hotone Bass Press. A wah voiced for bass, keeping low end intact while the sweep moves through the mids. Range, Q and Position shape it, Volume sets level.
WAH:83886087.pt: Inspirado no Hotone Bass Press. Wah voltado para baixo, que preserva os graves enquanto a varredura passa pelos médios. Range, Q e Position moldam o efeito; Volume ajusta o nível.

WAH:16777231.name: AUTOWAH
WAH:16777231.en: An original envelope filter that opens and closes with your picking dynamics, for funky quacks. Sense sets the response, Range and Q the sweep, Mode the shape, Mix the blend.
WAH:16777231.pt: Filtro de envelope original que abre e fecha conforme a dinâmica da palhetada, para aquele 'quá' funkeado. Sense define a resposta, Range e Q a varredura, Mode a forma e Mix a mistura.

WAH:16777237.name: LFO-FLT
WAH:16777237.en: An original auto filter swept by an LFO for rhythmic wah-like movement. Depth and Rate set the sweep, Low, Q and High shape the range, Sync locks it to tempo.
WAH:16777237.pt: Auto filtro original movido por LFO, com movimento rítmico tipo wah. Depth e Rate definem a varredura, Low, Q e High moldam a faixa e Sync trava no tempo.

DRV:50331648.name: SKR
DRV:50331648.en: Inspired by Ibanez TS808. The legendary mid-hump overdrive that tightens low end and pushes an amp into singing sustain. Gain sets the grit, Tone the brightness, Volume the level.
DRV:50331648.pt: Inspirado no Ibanez TS808. O lendário overdrive de médios salientes que enxuga os graves e leva o amp a um sustain cantante. Gain define a sujeira, Tone o brilho e Volume o nível.

DRV:50331649.name: SKR2
DRV:50331649.en: Inspired by Ibanez TS9. The classic green overdrive with a mid-focused, slightly brighter feel than its older sibling. Gain sets the drive, Tone the brightness, Volume the level.
DRV:50331649.pt: Inspirado no Ibanez TS9. O clássico overdrive verde, com foco nos médios e um toque mais brilhante que o irmão mais velho. Gain define o drive, Tone o brilho e Volume o nível.

DRV:50331650.name: SOFT-D
DRV:50331650.en: Inspired by Boss OD-1. An early, simple overdrive with an open, slightly asymmetrical crunch. Gain sets the drive and Volume the output, with no tone control.
DRV:50331650.pt: Inspirado no Boss OD-1. Overdrive antigo e simples, com crunch aberto e levemente assimétrico. Gain define o drive e Volume a saída, sem controle de tone.

DRV:50331652.name: VELV-D
DRV:50331652.en: Inspired by Providence SOV-2. A boutique overdrive with a smooth, dynamic response that stays articulate when pushed. Gain sets the drive, Tone the brightness, Volume the level.
DRV:50331652.pt: Inspirado no Providence SOV-2. Overdrive boutique de resposta suave e dinâmica, que mantém a articulação quando exigido. Gain define o drive, Tone o brilho e Volume o nível.

DRV:50331654.name: YLW-D
DRV:50331654.en: Inspired by Boss SD-1 (Japan-made). A crunchy, asymmetrical overdrive with a touch more bite than a TS-style pedal. Gain sets the drive, Tone the brightness, Volume the level.
DRV:50331654.pt: Inspirado no Boss SD-1 (fabricação japonesa). Overdrive crocante e assimétrico, com um pouco mais de mordida que um estilo TS. Gain define o drive, Tone o brilho e Volume o nível.

DRV:50331657.name: BLU-OD
DRV:50331657.en: Inspired by Boss BD-2. A Blues Driver known for open, amp-like overdrive that cleans up well with the guitar volume. Gain sets the drive, Tone the brightness, Volume the level.
DRV:50331657.pt: Inspirado no Boss BD-2. Um Blues Driver de overdrive aberto e parecido com amp, que limpa bem ao baixar o volume da guitarra. Gain define o drive, Tone o brilho e Volume o nível.

DRV:50331658.name: AMBR-D
DRV:50331658.en: Inspired by Fulltone OCD. A dynamic overdrive that goes from light break-up to heavy crunch with a tube-amp feel. Gain, Tone and Volume are the basics, Mode switches the clipping range.
DRV:50331658.pt: Inspirado no Fulltone OCD. Overdrive dinâmico que vai de leve break-up a crunch pesado, com sensação de amp valvulado. Gain, Tone e Volume são o básico; Mode troca a faixa de clipping.

DRV:50331662.name: BRTN-D
DRV:50331662.en: Inspired by Marshall Bluesbreaker. A warm, touch-sensitive overdrive with a creamy British crunch, great for blues and classic rock. Gain, Tone and Volume are the controls.
DRV:50331662.pt: Inspirado no Marshall Bluesbreaker. Overdrive quente e sensível à palhetada, com crunch britânico cremoso, ótimo para blues e rock clássico. Os controles são Gain, Tone e Volume.

DRV:50331664.name: LOTUS
DRV:50331664.en: Inspired by Hermida Zendrive. A boutique overdrive with a rich, vocal midrange and amp-like feel. Gain, Tone and Volume set the sound, Voice shifts its character.
DRV:50331664.pt: Inspirado no Hermida Zendrive. Overdrive boutique com médios ricos e vocais e sensação de amp. Gain, Tone e Volume definem o som e Voice muda o caráter.

DRV:50331678.name: CLR-D
DRV:50331678.en: Inspired by Paul Cochrane Timmy (V2). A transparent low-gain overdrive that keeps your amp's tone and adds touch-sensitive grit. Gain, Volume, Bass and Treble shape it, Mode changes the clipping.
DRV:50331678.pt: Inspirado no Paul Cochrane Timmy (V2). Overdrive transparente de ganho baixo, que preserva o timbre do amp e soma sujeira sensível à palhetada. Gain, Volume, Bass e Treble moldam; Mode muda o clipping.

DRV:50331663.name: MSTR-D
DRV:50331663.en: Inspired by Marshall Drivemaster. A British-voiced overdrive with a three-band EQ for classic crunch and gain. Gain and Volume set drive and level, Bass, Middle and Treble shape the tone.
DRV:50331663.pt: Inspirado no Marshall Drivemaster. Overdrive de voz britânica com EQ de três bandas, para crunch clássico e mais ganho. Gain e Volume ajustam drive e nível; Bass, Middle e Treble moldam o timbre.

DRV:50331686.name: GRWL-F
DRV:50331686.en: Inspired by Sola Sound Tone Bender Mk II. A vintage germanium-style fuzz with a raw, gated and woolly sound from the 1960s. Fuzz sets the saturation and Volume the output.
DRV:50331686.pt: Inspirado no Sola Sound Tone Bender Mk II. Fuzz vintage estilo germânio, com som cru, gated e lanoso dos anos 60. Fuzz define a saturação e Volume a saída.

DRV:50331682.name: SUST-F
DRV:50331682.en: Inspired by Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi. A thick, creamy sustaining fuzz for singing leads and huge rhythm walls. Sustain sets the fuzz, Tone sweeps dark to bright, Volume sets level.
DRV:50331682.pt: Inspirado no Electro-Harmonix Big Muff Pi. Fuzz espesso e cremoso, com sustain longo, para solos cantados e bases enormes. Sustain define o fuzz, Tone vai do escuro ao brilhante e Volume ajusta o nível.

DRV:50331684.name: FUZZ-G
DRV:50331684.en: Inspired by Dallas-Arbiter Fuzz Face (germanium). A round, touch-responsive fuzz that cleans up when you turn down the guitar. Fuzz sets the saturation and Volume the level.
DRV:50331684.pt: Inspirado no Dallas-Arbiter Fuzz Face (germânio). Fuzz redondo e sensível ao toque, que limpa ao baixar o volume da guitarra. Fuzz define a saturação e Volume o nível.

DRV:50331690.name: CRSH-D
DRV:50331690.en: Inspired by Boss DS-1 (Japan-made). A bright, punchy hard-clipping distortion used in rock and metal for decades. Gain sets the distortion, Tone the brightness, Volume the level.
DRV:50331690.pt: Inspirado no Boss DS-1 (fabricação japonesa). Distorção brilhante e direta de clipping duro, usada há décadas no rock e no metal. Gain define a distorção, Tone o brilho e Volume o nível.

DRV:50331691.name: GRIT-D
DRV:50331691.en: Inspired by ProCo The Rat (LM308 version). A gritty, aggressive distortion with a tight, biting midrange. Gain sets the distortion, Filter darkens the top end, Volume sets level.
DRV:50331691.pt: Inspirado no ProCo The Rat (versão LM308). Distorção áspera e agressiva, com médios firmes e mordentes. Gain define a distorção, Filter escurece os agudos e Volume ajusta o nível.

DRV:50331693.name: BRIT-D
DRV:50331693.en: Inspired by Marshall Guv'nor. A British-flavored distortion that mimics a stack in a box, with a three-band EQ. Gain and Volume set drive and level, Bass, Middle and Treble shape it.
DRV:50331693.pt: Inspirado no Marshall Guv'nor. Distorção de sabor britânico que simula um stack numa caixinha, com EQ de três bandas. Gain e Volume ajustam drive e nível; Bass, Middle e Treble moldam o timbre.

DRV:50331694.name: SLAY-D
DRV:50331694.en: Inspired by Marshall Shred Master. A high-gain pedal with a tight, saturated 80s metal sound and a Contour control. Gain and Volume set drive, Bass, Contour and Treble shape the voice.
DRV:50331694.pt: Inspirado no Marshall Shred Master. Pedal de alto ganho com som saturado e fechado do metal dos anos 80 e controle Contour. Gain e Volume ajustam o drive; Bass, Contour e Treble moldam a voz.

DRV:50331689.name: OPAMP-D
DRV:50331689.en: Inspired by MXR M104 Distortion+. A simple, punchy distortion with a classic 70s rock crunch. Gain sets the drive and Volume the output.
DRV:50331689.pt: Inspirado no MXR M104 Distortion+. Distorção simples e encorpada, com o crunch clássico do rock dos anos 70. Gain define o drive e Volume a saída.

DRV:50331696.name: CRNCH
DRV:50331696.en: Inspired by MI Audio Crunch Box. A British-style crunch that behaves like a cranked tube amp, from light grit to full distortion. Gain, Tone and Volume are the controls.
DRV:50331696.pt: Inspirado no MI Audio Crunch Box. Crunch de estilo britânico que soa como um amp valvulado no talo, de leve sujeira a distorção cheia. Gain, Tone e Volume são os controles.

DRV:50331698.name: ROAR-D
DRV:50331698.en: Inspired by Suhr Riot. A tight, modern distortion with a lot of range, from classic rock crunch to high gain. Gain, Tone and Volume are the basics, Mode changes the gain voicing.
DRV:50331698.pt: Inspirado no Suhr Riot. Distorção moderna e firme, com muita amplitude, de crunch de rock clássico a alto ganho. Gain, Tone e Volume são o básico; Mode muda a voz do ganho.

DRV:50331730.name: HOT-OD
DRV:50331730.en: Inspired by Friedman BE-OD. A high-gain pedal that captures a modded-Marshall roar, with tight lows and rich harmonics. Gain and Volume set drive, Bass, Treble and Presence shape it, Tight firms up the low end.
DRV:50331730.pt: Inspirado no Friedman BE-OD. Pedal de alto ganho que lembra o rugido de um Marshall modificado, com graves firmes e harmônicos ricos. Gain e Volume ajustam o drive; Bass, Treble e Presence moldam; Tight enxuga os graves.

DRV:50331711.name: BASS-OD
DRV:50331711.en: An original bass overdrive that adds grit while keeping the low end solid. Gain and Tone set the drive and color, Mode picks the voicing, Blend mixes in your clean signal.
DRV:50331711.pt: Overdrive original para baixo, que soma sujeira sem perder a firmeza dos graves. Gain e Tone definem drive e cor, Mode escolhe a voz e Blend mistura o sinal limpo.

DRV:50331712.name: BASS-CR
DRV:50331712.en: Inspired by Boss ODB-3. A heavy bass overdrive with a thick, aggressive growl. Gain sets the drive, Blend mixes in the clean low end, Bass and Treble shape the tone, Volume sets level.
DRV:50331712.pt: Inspirado no Boss ODB-3. Overdrive pesado para baixo, com rosnado grosso e agressivo. Gain define o drive, Blend mistura o grave limpo, Bass e Treble moldam o timbre e Volume ajusta o nível.

AMP:117440513.name: TWEED-S
AMP:117440513.en: Inspired by Fender Tweed Deluxe 5E3. A small tweed combo with a woolly, touch-sensitive break-up. Cleans fast into raw, dynamic crunch as Gain goes up. Tone and Volume are the controls.
AMP:117440513.pt: Inspirado no Fender Tweed Deluxe 5E3. Combo pequeno de tweed, de break-up lanoso e sensível ao toque. Vai do limpo ao crunch cru e dinâmico conforme sobe o Gain. Os controles são Tone e Volume.

AMP:117440515.name: TWEED-B
AMP:117440515.en: Inspired by Fender 5F6-A Tweed Bassman (normal input). A big, round tweed sound with fat lows and a smooth, vintage breakup. Gain, Presence and Volume set the push, Bass, Middle and Treble shape it.
AMP:117440515.pt: Inspirado no Fender 5F6-A Tweed Bassman (normal input). Som de tweed grande e redondo, com graves gordos e break-up suave e vintage. Gain, Presence e Volume definem o empurrão; Bass, Middle e Treble moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440548.name: TWEED-BR
AMP:117440548.en: Inspired by Fender 5F6-A Tweed Bassman (bright input). The bright input of the tweed classic, with more bite and a quicker slide into crunch. Gain, Presence and Volume set the push, Bass, Middle and Treble shape it.
AMP:117440548.pt: Inspirado no Fender 5F6-A Tweed Bassman (bright input). A entrada bright do clássico tweed, com mais mordida e entrada mais rápida no crunch. Gain, Presence e Volume definem o empurrão; Bass, Middle e Treble moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440516.name: BLK-BIG
AMP:117440516.en: Inspired by Fender '65 Blackface Twin Reverb. The benchmark American clean: loud, sparkling and wide open with scooped mids. Great for pedal platforms and chiming chords. Bass, Treble and the Bright switch shape the sparkle.
AMP:117440516.pt: Inspirado no Fender '65 Blackface Twin Reverb. O limpo americano de referência: alto, cintilante e aberto, com médios abertos. Perfeito para pedais e acordes cristalinos. Bass, Treble e o Bright moldam o brilho.

AMP:117440517.name: BLK-MED
AMP:117440517.en: Inspired by Fender Blackface Deluxe Reverb (normal channel). A medium-size American combo with sweet, glassy cleans that crunch up nicely when pushed. Gain and Volume set the push, Bass and Treble shape the tone.
AMP:117440517.pt: Inspirado no Fender Blackface Deluxe Reverb (normal channel). Combo americano de tamanho médio, com limpos doces e cristalinos que viram um bom crunch quando exigidos. Gain e Volume definem o empurrão; Bass e Treble moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440527.name: DUAL-C
AMP:117440527.en: Inspired by Supro Dual-Tone 1624T. A small vintage amp with a raw, spongy and slightly gritty clean tone. Good for blues and garage sounds. Gain, Tone and Volume are the controls.
AMP:117440527.pt: Inspirado no Supro Dual-Tone 1624T. Amp vintage pequeno, com limpo cru, esponjoso e levemente sujo. Bom para blues e som de garagem. Os controles são Gain, Tone e Volume.

AMP:117440552.name: DUAL-D
AMP:117440552.en: Inspired by Supro Dual-Tone 1624T (channels 1+2). Both channels of the small vintage amp linked for a thicker, more driven tone. Gain 1, Tone 1, Gain 2 and Tone 2 blend two voices, Volume sets level.
AMP:117440552.pt: Inspirado no Supro Dual-Tone 1624T (channels 1+2). Os dois canais do amp vintage pequeno ligados, para um timbre mais grosso e saturado. Gain 1, Tone 1, Gain 2 e Tone 2 misturam duas vozes; Volume ajusta o nível.

AMP:117440528.name: CHIME-15
AMP:117440528.en: Inspired by VOX AC15 Top Boost. A chimey British combo with jangly highs and a lively, compressed feel. Tone Cut tames the top end, Bass and Treble shape the voice, Gain and Volume set the drive.
AMP:117440528.pt: Inspirado no VOX AC15 Top Boost. Combo britânico cristalino, com agudos 'jangly' e resposta viva e comprimida. Tone Cut doma os agudos, Bass e Treble moldam a voz e Gain e Volume definem o drive.

AMP:117440529.name: CHIME-30
AMP:117440529.en: Inspired by VOX AC30. The classic British chime amp in its clean setting: glassy, rich in harmonics and responsive. Gain, Tone Cut, Volume and Bright set the sparkle.
AMP:117440529.pt: Inspirado no VOX AC30. O clássico amp britânico de brilho cristalino no ajuste limpo: vítreo, rico em harmônicos e responsivo. Gain, Tone Cut, Volume e Bright definem o brilho.

AMP:117440551.name: CHIME-30D
AMP:117440551.en: Inspired by VOX AC30. A pushed version of the British chime amp, with a rich, harmonic crunch. Gain, Volume, Bass, Treble and Tone Cut shape the sound, Char adds character.
AMP:117440551.pt: Inspirado no VOX AC30. Versão exigida do amp britânico cristalino, com crunch harmônico e rico. Gain, Volume, Bass, Treble e Tone Cut moldam o som e Char acrescenta caráter.

AMP:117440532.name: SOLID-C
AMP:117440532.en: Inspired by Roland JC120. The famous solid-state clean: crisp, huge and pristine, ideal for chorus and pedals. Gain, Bass, Middle, Treble and Bright set the tone.
AMP:117440532.pt: Inspirado no Roland JC120. O famoso limpo transistorizado: nítido, enorme e cristalino, ideal para chorus e pedais. Gain, Bass, Middle, Treble e Bright definem o timbre.

AMP:117440533.name: BOUT-C
AMP:117440533.en: Inspired by Matchless Chieftain (low input). A boutique British-American clean with chimey highs and a rich, touch-sensitive response. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440533.pt: Inspirado no Matchless Chieftain (low input). Limpo boutique de pegada anglo-americana, com agudos brilhantes e resposta rica e sensível ao toque. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440584.name: BOUT-H
AMP:117440584.en: Inspired by Matchless Chieftain (high input). The hotter input of the boutique combo, giving a thicker, more overdriven sound with great touch response. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440584.pt: Inspirado no Matchless Chieftain (high input). A entrada mais quente do combo boutique, para um som mais grosso e saturado com ótima resposta ao toque. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440537.name: TEX-C
AMP:117440537.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Lone Star (channel 1). The clean channel of a versatile boutique amp, with a full body and detailed highs. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440537.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Lone Star (channel 1). O canal limpo de um amp boutique versátil, com corpo cheio e agudos detalhados. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440586.name: TEX-D
AMP:117440586.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Lone Star (channel 2). The driven channel of the same amp, giving a smooth, rich overdrive with sustain. Input, Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440586.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Lone Star (channel 2). O canal saturado do mesmo amp, com overdrive suave e rico, cheio de sustain. Input, Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440538.name: EURO-C
AMP:117440538.en: Inspired by Bogner Shiva (20th anniversary, clean channel). A lush, hi-fi clean from a boutique German-style amp, with a big low end and sparkly top. Gain, Presence, Volume, Bass, Treble and Bright shape it.
AMP:117440538.pt: Inspirado no Bogner Shiva (20th anniversary, clean channel). Limpo exuberante e hi-fi de um amp boutique, com graves amplos e topo cintilante. Gain, Presence, Volume, Bass, Treble e Bright moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440573.name: EURO-D
AMP:117440573.en: Inspired by Bogner Shiva. A rich, creamy overdrive from a boutique amp, great for blues-rock and smooth leads. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440573.pt: Inspirado no Bogner Shiva. Overdrive rico e cremoso de um amp boutique, ótimo para blues-rock e solos suaves. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440579.name: EURO-BLU
AMP:117440579.en: Inspired by Bogner Ecstasy blue channel (vintage). A boutique crunch channel with a rich, open drive, from classic rock to warm leads. Gain, Presence, Volume, Bass, Middle and Treble.
AMP:117440579.pt: Inspirado no Bogner Ecstasy blue channel (vintage). Canal de crunch boutique com drive rico e aberto, do rock clássico aos solos quentes. Gain, Presence, Volume, Bass, Middle e Treble.

AMP:117440622.name: EURO-HG
AMP:117440622.en: Inspired by Bogner Ecstasy XTC (red channel, modern). A modern high-gain voice with tight lows, strong mids and plenty of sustain. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440622.pt: Inspirado no Bogner Ecstasy XTC (red channel, modern). Voz moderna de alto ganho, com graves firmes, médios fortes e muito sustain. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440539.name: SWNG-C
AMP:117440539.en: Inspired by Dr. Z Maz 38 (low input). A boutique class-AB combo with a rich, clear clean that bites when pushed. Tone Cut tames the top, Gain, Volume and a three-band EQ do the rest.
AMP:117440539.pt: Inspirado no Dr. Z Maz 38 (low input). Combo boutique classe AB com limpo rico e claro, que morde quando exigido. Tone Cut doma os agudos; Gain, Volume e EQ de três bandas fazem o resto.

AMP:117440585.name: SWNG-D
AMP:117440585.en: Inspired by Dr. Z Maz 38 (high input). The hot input of the boutique combo, adding grit and sustain for bluesy, dynamic overdrive. Gain, Tone Cut, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440585.pt: Inspirado no Dr. Z Maz 38 (high input). A entrada quente do combo boutique, que soma sujeira e sustain para um overdrive bluesy e dinâmico. Gain, Tone Cut, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440543.name: UKB-C
AMP:117440543.en: Inspired by Grindrod Pendragon. A boutique amp clean tone with clarity and a warm, open feel. Gain and Volume set the push, Bass, Middle and Treble shape the voice.
AMP:117440543.pt: Inspirado no Grindrod Pendragon. Limpo de amp boutique, com clareza e sensação quente e aberta. Gain e Volume definem o empurrão; Bass, Middle e Treble moldam a voz.

AMP:117440635.name: UKB-CB
AMP:117440635.en: Inspired by Grindrod Pendragon (bright). The bright voicing of the boutique clean, with extra shimmer and bite. Gain and Volume set the push, Bass, Middle and Treble shape the voice.
AMP:117440635.pt: Inspirado no Grindrod Pendragon (bright). A voz bright do limpo boutique, com brilho e mordida extras. Gain e Volume definem o empurrão; Bass, Middle e Treble moldam a voz.

AMP:117440636.name: UKB-D
AMP:117440636.en: Inspired by Grindrod Pendragon (drive). The driven side of the boutique amp, with a warm, saturated crunch. Gain and Volume set the push, Bass, Middle and Treble shape the voice.
AMP:117440636.pt: Inspirado no Grindrod Pendragon (drive). O lado saturado do amp boutique, com crunch quente e saturado. Gain e Volume definem o empurrão; Bass, Middle e Treble moldam a voz.

AMP:117440547.name: SPIKE-C
AMP:117440547.en: Inspired by Soldano SLO-100 (clean). The clean setting of a legendary high-gain amp: full, clear and punchy. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440547.pt: Inspirado no Soldano SLO-100 (clean). O ajuste limpo de um lendário amp de alto ganho: cheio, claro e com punch. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440583.name: SPIKE-D
AMP:117440583.en: Inspired by Soldano SLO-100 (crunch). A thick, singing crunch from a legendary high-gain amp, great for rock rhythm. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440583.pt: Inspirado no Soldano SLO-100 (crunch). Crunch grosso e cantante de um lendário amp de alto ganho, ótimo para base de rock. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440601.name: SPIKE-HG
AMP:117440601.en: Inspired by Soldano SLO-100 (overdrive channel). Smooth, saturated high gain with huge sustain and a vocal midrange, made for leads. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440601.pt: Inspirado no Soldano SLO-100 (overdrive channel). Alto ganho suave e saturado, com sustain enorme e médios vocais, feito para solos. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440554.name: BRT45-N
AMP:117440554.en: Inspired by Marshall JTM45 (normal). An early British plexi-era sound, warm and dark with soft crunch. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440554.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JTM45 (normal). Som britânico da era plexi, quente e escuro, com crunch suave. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440555.name: BRT45-T
AMP:117440555.en: Inspired by Marshall JTM45 (treble). The brighter channel of an early British stack, with more bite and clarity. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440555.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JTM45 (treble). O canal mais brilhante de um stack britânico antigo, com mais mordida e clareza. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440556.name: BRT45-J
AMP:117440556.en: Inspired by Marshall JTM45 (jumpered channels). Both channels of the early British amp linked for a fuller, thicker tone. Gain 1 and Gain 2 blend the inputs, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440556.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JTM45 (jumpered channels). Os dois canais do amp britânico antigo ligados, para um timbre mais cheio e grosso. Gain 1 e Gain 2 misturam as entradas; Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440557.name: BRT50-N
AMP:117440557.en: Inspired by Marshall JMP 50 (normal). A 50-watt plexi-style sound, warm with a woolly crunch for classic rock. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440557.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JMP 50 (normal). Som estilo plexi de 50 watts, quente e de crunch lanoso, para rock clássico. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440558.name: BRT50-T
AMP:117440558.en: Inspired by Marshall JMP 50 (treble). The brighter channel of a 50-watt plexi-style amp, cutting and aggressive. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440558.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JMP 50 (treble). O canal mais brilhante de um amp plexi de 50 watts, cortante e agressivo. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440559.name: BRT50-J
AMP:117440559.en: Inspired by Marshall JMP 50 (jumpered channels). Both channels of the 50-watt plexi-style amp linked for the classic fat rock sound. Gain 1 and Gain 2 blend inputs, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440559.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JMP 50 (jumpered channels). Os dois canais do amp plexi de 50 watts ligados para o clássico som gordo de rock. Gain 1 e Gain 2 misturam as entradas; Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440560.name: BRT100-N
AMP:117440560.en: Inspired by Marshall Super Lead Plexi (normal). A loud 100-watt plexi-style sound with thick crunch and sparkle. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440560.pt: Inspirado no Marshall Super Lead Plexi (normal). Som plexi de 100 watts, alto, com crunch grosso e brilho. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440565.name: BRIT-LD
AMP:117440565.en: Inspired by Marshall JCM800. The sound of 80s hard rock: tight, punchy crunch with a cutting midrange. Great with a boost in front. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440565.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JCM800. O som do hard rock dos anos 80: crunch firme e encorpado, com médios cortantes. Fica ótimo com um boost na frente. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440590.name: BRIT-HG
AMP:117440590.en: Inspired by Marshall JCM900. A British high-gain amp with a raw, tight and aggressive crunch for hard rock and metal. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440590.pt: Inspirado no Marshall JCM900. Amp britânico de alto ganho, com crunch cru, firme e agressivo, para hard rock e metal. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440576.name: HOT-A
AMP:117440576.en: Inspired by Friedman BE-100 (BE channel). A hot-rodded British crunch with tight lows and rich harmonics. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440576.pt: Inspirado no Friedman BE-100 (BE channel). Crunch britânico envenenado, com graves firmes e harmônicos ricos. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440577.name: HOT-B
AMP:117440577.en: Inspired by Friedman BE-100 (BE channel, alt). An alternate voicing of the hot-rodded British crunch, with tight lows and rich harmonics. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440577.pt: Inspirado no Friedman BE-100 (BE channel, alt). Uma voz alternativa do crunch britânico envenenado, com graves firmes e harmônicos ricos. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440605.name: HOT+A
AMP:117440605.en: Inspired by Friedman BE-100 (HBE channel). A high-gain, saturated version of a hot-rodded British amp, with tight lows and a singing top. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440605.pt: Inspirado no Friedman BE-100 (HBE channel). Versão saturada de alto ganho de um amp britânico envenenado, com graves firmes e topo cantante. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440606.name: HOT+B
AMP:117440606.en: Inspired by Friedman BE-100 (HBE channel, alt). An alternate voicing of the high-gain hot-rodded British amp, with plenty of sustain and tight lows. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440606.pt: Inspirado no Friedman BE-100 (HBE channel, alt). Uma voz alternativa do amp britânico envenenado de alto ganho, com muito sustain e graves firmes. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440569.name: LD2-A
AMP:117440569.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Mark II C+. A thick, creamy lead voice from a classic boutique high-gain amp, famous for smooth sustain. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440569.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Mark II C+. Voz solo grossa e cremosa de um clássico amp boutique de alto ganho, famoso pelo sustain suave. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440570.name: LD2-B
AMP:117440570.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Mark II C+ (variant). A second voicing of the classic creamy lead amp, with the same smooth sustain and thick mids. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440570.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Mark II C+ (variant). Uma segunda voz do clássico amp de solo cremoso, com o mesmo sustain suave e médios grossos. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440571.name: LD2-C
AMP:117440571.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Mark II C+ (variant). A third voicing of the classic creamy lead amp, with smooth sustain and thick mids. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440571.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Mark II C+ (variant). Uma terceira voz do clássico amp de solo cremoso, com sustain suave e médios grossos. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440597.name: LD4-A
AMP:117440597.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Mark IV (lead channel). A tight, saturated lead tone with a scooped-yet-punchy voice, made for solos and modern rock. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440597.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Mark IV (lead channel). Timbre de solo firme e saturado, com voz escavada mas encorpada, feito para solos e rock moderno. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440598.name: LD4-B
AMP:117440598.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Mark IV (lead channel, variant). A second voicing of the tight, saturated lead channel for modern rock. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440598.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Mark IV (lead channel, variant). Uma segunda voz do canal de solo firme e saturado, para rock moderno. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440599.name: LD4-C

AMP:117440599.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Mark IV (lead channel, variant). Uma terceira voz do canal de solo firme e saturado, para rock moderno. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440616.name: MAX-V
AMP:117440616.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Dual Rectifier (channel 3, vintage). A big, loose and heavy high-gain sound in its vintage mode, with thick lows. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440616.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Dual Rectifier (channel 3, vintage). Som grande, solto e pesado de alto ganho no modo vintage, com graves grossos. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440617.name: MAX-M
AMP:117440617.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie Dual Rectifier (channel 3, modern). A tighter, more aggressive high-gain mode of a heavy rock staple, with a punchy low end. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440617.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Dual Rectifier (channel 3, modern). Modo de alto ganho mais firme e agressivo de um pilar do rock pesado, com graves encorpados. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440595.name: PUNCH
AMP:117440595.en: Inspired by Orange Rockerverb 100. A thick, raunchy high-gain British amp with a creamy midrange, great for stoner rock and heavy riffs. Gain, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440595.pt: Inspirado no Orange Rockerverb 100. Amp britânico de alto ganho grosso e sujo, com médios cremosos, ótimo para stoner rock e riffs pesados. Gain, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440602.name: BLITZ
AMP:117440602.en: Inspired by Peavey 5150. The tight, aggressive high-gain tone of 90s metal, with a punchy low end and razor top. Gain, Volume, Presence and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440602.pt: Inspirado no Peavey 5150. O timbre firme e agressivo do metal dos anos 90, com graves encorpados e topo cortante. Gain, Volume, Presence e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440607.name: GERM-A
AMP:117440607.en: Inspired by ENGL Savage 120 (channel 4). A tight, modern metal high-gain sound with a controlled low end and cutting top. Gain, Presence, Volume and a three-band EQ shape it.
AMP:117440607.pt: Inspirado no ENGL Savage 120 (channel 4). Som moderno de metal de alto ganho, firme, com graves controlados e topo cortante. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440608.name: GERM-B

AMP:117440608.pt: Inspirado no ENGL Savage 120 (channel 4, variant). Uma segunda voz do canal moderno de metal de alto ganho, firme. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440613.name: MTL-3B

AMP:117440613.pt: Inspirado no Diezel VH4 (channel 3, blue panel). Voz de solo saturada e densa, de alto ganho, com graves profundos e firmes. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440614.name: MTL-4S

AMP:117440614.pt: Inspirado no Diezel VH4 (channel 4, silver panel). Timbre moderno enorme e firme de alto ganho, com graves volumosos e articulação cristalina. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440618.name: MTL-4B

AMP:117440618.pt: Inspirado no Diezel VH4 (channel 4, blue panel). Voz saturada de alto ganho, com graves profundos e topo suave, ótima para metal moderno. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440619.name: MTL-4S2

AMP:117440619.pt: Inspirado no Diezel VH4 (channel 4, silver panel, alt). Uma voz alternativa do canal moderno de alto ganho enorme. Gain, Presence, Volume e EQ de três bandas moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440627.name: BASS-HD

AMP:117440627.pt: Inspirado no Ampeg SVT. O clássico cabeçote valvulado de baixo, alto, com graves grossos e encorpados e seletor de médios forte. Gain, Bass, Middle, Midrange, Treble e Volume moldam o timbre.

AMP:117440629.name: BASS-UK

AMP:117440629.pt: Inspirado no VOX AC100 (bass). Amp de baixo de estilo britânico, brilhante e claro, com som encorpado e articulado. Os controles são Volume, Bass e Treble.

AMP:117440631.name: BASS-MOD

AMP:117440631.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie Bass 400+. Amp de baixo moderno e potente, com graves grandes e claros e EQ flexível. Gain, Volume, Bass, Middle e Treble moldam o timbre.

AMP:134217845.name: BASS-FLP

AMP:134217845.pt: Inspirado no Ampeg B-15. Amp de baixo vintage quente, profundo e redondo, famoso pelo som clássico e encorpado. Os controles são Volume, Bass e Treble.

AMP:134217846.name: BASS-HI

AMP:134217850.name: ACO-A

CAB:167772212.pt: Inspirado no Ampeg B-15 Portaflex 1x15. O clássico 1x15 de baixo de estúdio: redondo, quente e encorpado. Perfeito para soul vintage e baixo com os dedos. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772216.name: Bass 4x10
CAB:167772216.en: Inspired by Ampeg 4x10. A punchy rock bass 4x10 with growl and tight lows. Great for rock and pick-played bass. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772216.pt: Inspirado no Ampeg 4x10. Caixa de baixo 4x10 de rock, com punch, rosnado e graves firmes. Ótima para rock e baixo tocado com palheta. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772219.name: Fridge 8x10
CAB:167772219.en: Inspired by Ampeg SVT 8x10. The huge rock bass 8x10: deep, growling lows and a powerful midrange. The classic big-stage rock bass sound. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772219.pt: Inspirado no Ampeg SVT 8x10. O enorme 8x10 de baixo de rock: graves profundos e rosnados e médios poderosos. O clássico som de baixo de palco grande. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772218.name: Bass 4x12
CAB:167772218.en: A 4x12 bass cabinet with a wide, punchy voice and a bright top. Good for aggressive rock bass. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772218.pt: Caixa de baixo 4x12 de voz larga e com punch e agudos brilhantes. Boa para baixo de rock agressivo. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772220.name: Dreadnought A
CAB:167772220.en: A dreadnought acoustic body for piezo or acoustic-sim signals: big, booming lows and strong strum. Great for rhythm. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772220.pt: Corpo de violão dreadnought para sinais de piezo ou simulador de violão: graves fortes e cheios para batida. Ótimo para base. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772221.name: Dreadnought B
CAB:167772221.en: A second dreadnought acoustic body for piezo signals, with a slightly different, more balanced voice. Good for strumming. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772221.pt: Um segundo corpo de violão dreadnought para piezo, de voz um pouco diferente e mais equilibrada. Bom para batidas. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772222.name: Orchestra
CAB:167772222.en: An orchestra-model acoustic body for piezo signals: balanced, clear and focused. Good for fingerpicking. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772222.pt: Corpo de violão modelo orquestra para piezo: equilibrado, claro e focado. Bom para dedilhado. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772223.name: Jumbo
CAB:167772223.en: A jumbo acoustic body for piezo signals, with a big, wide and powerful voice. Great for bold strumming. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772223.pt: Corpo de violão jumbo para piezo, de voz grande, larga e potente. Ótimo para batidas fortes. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772224.name: Square Dread
CAB:167772224.en: Inspired by Gibson Hummingbird. A square-shoulder dreadnought acoustic body for piezo signals, warm and woody with a sweet midrange. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772224.pt: Inspirado no Gibson Hummingbird. Corpo de violão dreadnought de ombros quadrados para piezo, quente e amadeirado, com médios doces. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772225.name: Auditorium
CAB:167772225.en: A grand auditorium acoustic body for piezo signals: articulate and versatile, from strum to fingerstyle. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772225.pt: Corpo de violão grand auditorium para piezo: articulado e versátil, da batida ao dedilhado. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772226.name: Nylon
CAB:167772226.en: A classical nylon-string guitar body for piezo signals, soft and warm. Good for bossa, classical and ballads. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772226.pt: Corpo de violão clássico de nylon para piezo, macio e quente. Bom para bossa, clássico e baladas. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772227.name: Mandolin
CAB:167772227.en: A mandolin body for piezo signals, bright and short with a sparkling top. Good for folk and bluegrass color. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772227.pt: Corpo de bandolim para piezo, brilhante e curto, com agudos cintilantes. Bom para dar cor de folk e bluegrass. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772228.name: Fretless
CAB:167772228.en: A fretless bass body for piezo bass signals, with a smooth, singing, woody tone. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772228.pt: Corpo de baixo fretless para sinais de baixo com piezo, de timbre suave, cantado e amadeirado. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

CAB:167772229.name: Upright
CAB:167772229.en: An upright double bass body for piezo bass signals, with a round, woody thump. Good for jazz and rockabilly. Volume sets the level; Low Cut and High Cut trim the lows and highs.
CAB:167772229.pt: Corpo de contrabaixo acústico para sinais de baixo com piezo, com som redondo e amadeirado. Bom para jazz e rockabilly. Volume ajusta o nível; Low Cut e High Cut aparam graves e agudos.

EQ:16777269.name: Guitar Mid EQ
EQ:16777269.en: A 5-band guitar graphic EQ focused on the mids, for shaping body and bite. 125 Hz, 400 Hz, 800 Hz, 1.6 kHz and 4 kHz bands, each ±50, plus Volume.
EQ:16777269.pt: EQ gráfico de 5 bandas para guitarra, focado nos médios, para moldar corpo e ataque. Bandas de 125 Hz, 400 Hz, 800 Hz, 1,6 kHz e 4 kHz, cada uma ±50, mais Volume.

EQ:16777270.name: Guitar Wide EQ
EQ:16777270.en: A 5-band guitar graphic EQ with a wider span, from low thump to top-end air. 100 Hz, 500 Hz, 1 kHz, 3 kHz and 6 kHz bands, each ±50, plus Volume.
EQ:16777270.pt: EQ gráfico de 5 bandas para guitarra com faixa mais ampla, do peso dos graves ao ar dos agudos. Bandas de 100 Hz, 500 Hz, 1 kHz, 3 kHz e 6 kHz, cada uma ±50, mais Volume.

EQ:16777273.name: Bass Wide EQ
EQ:16777273.en: A 5-band bass graphic EQ from deep sub to string click. 33 Hz, 150 Hz, 600 Hz, 2 kHz and 8 kHz bands, each ±50, plus Volume.
EQ:16777273.pt: EQ gráfico de 5 bandas para baixo, do subgrave ao estalo das cordas. Bandas de 33 Hz, 150 Hz, 600 Hz, 2 kHz e 8 kHz, cada uma ±50, mais Volume.

EQ:16777274.name: Bass Mid EQ
EQ:16777274.en: A 5-band bass graphic EQ for punch and growl in the low mids. 50 Hz, 120 Hz, 400 Hz, 800 Hz and 4.5 kHz bands, each ±50, plus Volume.
EQ:16777274.pt: EQ gráfico de 5 bandas para baixo, para punch e rosnado nos médios-graves. Bandas de 50 Hz, 120 Hz, 400 Hz, 800 Hz e 4,5 kHz, cada uma ±50, mais Volume.

EQ:16777276.name: Graphic EQ
EQ:16777276.en: Inspired by Mesa/Boogie 5-band graphic EQ. The classic V-curve lead and metal shaper. 80 Hz, 240 Hz, 750 Hz, 2.2 kHz and 6.6 kHz bands, each ±50.
EQ:16777276.pt: Inspirado no Mesa/Boogie 5-band graphic EQ. O clássico modelador em V para solo e metal. Bandas de 80 Hz, 240 Hz, 750 Hz, 2,2 kHz e 6,6 kHz, cada uma ±50.

MOD:67108865.name: CHOR-VTG
MOD:67108865.en: Inspired by Boss CE-1 (chorus mode). The legendary early chorus: lush, warm and wide, the sound of 80s clean guitars. Depth and Rate set the motion, Volume the level, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108865.pt: Inspirado no Boss CE-1 (chorus mode). O lendário chorus antigo: exuberante, quente e largo, o som das guitarras limpas dos anos 80. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Volume o nível e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108866.name: CHOR-WIDE
MOD:67108866.en: Inspired by Boss DC-2. A dual-band chorus with a clear, shimmering sweep that leaves the low end intact. Mode picks the chorus voicing.
MOD:67108866.pt: Inspirado no Boss DC-2. Chorus de duas bandas com varredura clara e cintilante, que preserva os graves. Mode escolhe a voz do chorus.

MOD:67108872.name: CHOR-B
MOD:67108872.en: Inspired by Boss CE-2B. A bass-friendly analog chorus with a smooth, gentle sweep. Depth and Rate set the motion, Volume the level, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108872.pt: Inspirado no Boss CE-2B. Chorus analógico amigo do baixo, com varredura suave e delicada. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Volume o nível e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108879.name: CHOR-TRI
MOD:67108879.en: An original three-voice chorus with independent depths for left, center and right for a wide stereo image. Mix, Rate and Filter set the tone, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108879.pt: Chorus original de três vozes, com profundidades independentes para esquerda, centro e direita, criando uma imagem estéreo ampla. Mix, Rate e Filter definem o timbre e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108881.name: FLNG-JET
MOD:67108881.en: An original flanger with the swooshing, jet-plane sweep. Depth and Rate set the motion, Pre Delay and Feedback shape the resonance, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108881.pt: Flanger original com aquela varredura de 'avião a jato'. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Pre Delay e Feedback moldam a ressonância e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108883.name: FLNG-DEEP
MOD:67108883.en: An original flanger with a second voicing for a deeper, more metallic sweep. Depth and Rate set the motion, Pre Delay and Feedback shape the resonance, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108883.pt: Flanger original com uma segunda voz, de varredura mais profunda e metálica. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Pre Delay e Feedback moldam a ressonância e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108884.name: FLNG-TR
MOD:67108884.en: An original combo of flanger and tremolo in one slot. Flg Depth, Flg Rate and Feedback set the flanging, Trm Depth and Trm Rate the tremolo, each with its own Sync.
MOD:67108884.pt: Combo original de flanger e tremolo num só slot. Flg Depth, Flg Rate e Feedback definem o flanger, Trm Depth e Trm Rate o tremolo, cada um com seu Sync.

MOD:67108882.name: FLNG-BASS
MOD:67108882.en: A flanger voiced for bass that keeps the low end solid while the sweep moves above it. Depth and Rate set the motion, Pre Delay and Feedback the resonance, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108882.pt: Flanger voltado para baixo, que mantém os graves firmes enquanto a varredura acontece acima deles. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Pre Delay e Feedback a ressonância e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108887.name: VIB-WOBBLE
MOD:67108887.en: An original vibrato that rocks the pitch up and down for a wobbling, seasick effect. Depth and Rate set the motion, Volume the level, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108887.pt: Vibrato original que balança a afinação para cima e para baixo, num efeito ondulante. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Volume o nível e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108885.name: VIB-PURE
MOD:67108885.en: Inspired by Boss VB-2. A pure pitch vibrato with a smooth, vintage wobble. Depth and Rate set the intensity and speed, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108885.pt: Inspirado no Boss VB-2. Vibrato puro de afinação, com ondulação suave e vintage. Depth e Rate ajustam intensidade e velocidade e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108886.name: VIB-VTG
MOD:67108886.en: Inspired by Boss CE-1 (vibrato mode). The vibrato side of the legendary early chorus, deep and smooth. Depth and Rate set the motion, Volume the level, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108886.pt: Inspirado no Boss CE-1 (vibrato mode). O lado vibrato do lendário chorus antigo, fundo e suave. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Volume o nível e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108889.name: PHAS-A
MOD:67108889.en: Inspired by MXR Phase 90. The classic orange phaser with a smooth, swirling sweep that suits rock and funk. Rate sets the speed, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108889.pt: Inspirado no MXR Phase 90. O clássico phaser laranja, com varredura suave e giratória, ideal para rock e funk. Rate define a velocidade e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108890.name: PHAS-VTG
MOD:67108890.en: Inspired by Boss PH-1. A warm, vintage phaser with a smooth, gentle sweep. Depth and Rate set the intensity and speed, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108890.pt: Inspirado no Boss PH-1. Phaser vintage e quente, com varredura suave e delicada. Depth e Rate ajustam intensidade e velocidade e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108891.name: PHAS-S
MOD:67108891.en: Inspired by Electro-Harmonix Small Stone. A lush, resonant phaser famous for its dreamy 70s swirl. Color sets the resonance, Rate sets the speed, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108891.pt: Inspirado no Electro-Harmonix Small Stone. Phaser exuberante e ressonante, famoso pelo giro sonhador dos anos 70. Color define a ressonância, Rate a velocidade e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108894.name: PHAS-PN
MOD:67108894.en: An original phaser combined with an auto-pan. Phs Depth and Phs Rate shape the phasing, Pan Depth and Pan Rate move it across the stereo field, each with its own Sync.
MOD:67108894.pt: Phaser original combinado com auto-pan. Phs Depth e Phs Rate moldam o phaser, Pan Depth e Pan Rate o movem pelo campo estéreo, cada um com seu Sync.

MOD:67108895.name: PHAS-V
MOD:67108895.en: Inspired by Voodoo Lab Micro Vibe. A throbbing, vibe-style phaser inspired by the classic 60s sound of liquid, pulsing swirls. Depth and Rate set the motion, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108895.pt: Inspirado no Voodoo Lab Micro Vibe. Phaser estilo vibe, pulsante, inspirado no som clássico dos anos 60, de giros líquidos. Depth e Rate definem o movimento e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108896.name: PULS-V
MOD:67108896.en: Inspired by Shin-Ei Uni-Vibe. The legendary pulsing phaser/vibrato of the 60s and 70s, liquid and organic. Depth and Rate set the motion, Volume the level, Mode picks chorus or vibrato, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108896.pt: Inspirado no Shin-Ei Uni-Vibe. O lendário phaser/vibrato pulsante dos anos 60 e 70, líquido e orgânico. Depth e Rate definem o movimento, Volume o nível, Mode escolhe chorus ou vibrato e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108897.name: TREM-D
MOD:67108897.en: Inspired by Demeter Tremulator. A smooth, studio-grade tremolo with a deep, throbbing pulse. Depth and Rate set the intensity and speed, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108897.pt: Inspirado no Demeter Tremulator. Tremolo suave e de qualidade de estúdio, com pulso fundo e latejante. Depth e Rate ajustam intensidade e velocidade e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108902.name: TREM-SINE
MOD:67108902.en: A tremolo with a smooth sine-wave pulse, great for surf and vintage sounds. Depth and Rate set the intensity and speed, Volume the level, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108902.pt: Tremolo de pulso suave em onda senoidal, ótimo para surf e sons vintage. Depth e Rate definem intensidade e velocidade, Volume o nível e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108903.name: TREM-TRI
MOD:67108903.en: A tremolo with a triangle-wave pulse, more even and pronounced than the sine one. Depth and Rate set the intensity and speed, Volume the level, Sync locks to tempo.
MOD:67108903.pt: Tremolo de pulso em onda triangular, mais uniforme e marcado que o senoidal. Depth e Rate definem intensidade e velocidade, Volume o nível e Sync trava no tempo.

MOD:67108904.name: TREM-BIAS
MOD:67108904.en: A tremolo with a Bias control, for the uneven, throbbing pulse of old tube amps. Depth and Rate set the intensity and speed, Bias shapes the pulse, Volume sets level.
MOD:67108904.pt: Tremolo com controle Bias, para o pulso irregular e latejante de amps valvulados antigos. Depth e Rate ajustam intensidade e velocidade, Bias molda o pulso e Volume o nível.

MOD:16777257.name: DETUNE
MOD:16777257.en: An original detuner that doubles your signal slightly out of tune, for a thick, chorus-like widening. Detune sets the amount, Wet and Dry balance the blend.
MOD:16777257.pt: Detuner original que dobra o sinal levemente desafinado, para um engrossamento tipo chorus. Detune define a quantidade; Wet e Dry equilibram a mistura.

MOD:16777262.name: CRUSH
MOD:16777262.en: An original lo-fi effect that crushes sample rate and bit depth for gritty, digital textures. Krush and Bit set the destruction, Hi Cut and Lo Cut shape the tone, Mix blends it.
MOD:16777262.pt: Efeito lo-fi original que reduz taxa de amostragem e bits, para texturas digitais ásperas. Krush e Bit definem a destruição, Hi Cut e Lo Cut moldam o timbre e Mix mistura.

DLY:184549377.name: Warm Analog
DLY:184549377.en: An analog-style delay with warm, darkening repeats that sit behind your playing. Mix, Time (20 ms to 4 s) and Feedback set the echoes, Sync locks to tempo, Trail lets them ring out.
DLY:184549377.pt: Delay estilo analógico, com repetições quentes que escurecem e ficam atrás da sua execução. Mix, Time (20 ms a 4 s) e Feedback definem os ecos, Sync trava no tempo e Trail os deixa soar.

DLY:184549376.name: Pure Digital
DLY:184549376.en: A clean digital delay with exact, full-range repeats. Great for rhythmic and dotted echoes. Mix, Time (20 ms to 4 s) and Feedback set the echoes, Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549376.pt: Delay digital limpo, com repetições exatas e de faixa completa. Ótimo para ecos rítmicos e pontuados. Mix, Time (20 ms a 4 s) e Feedback definem os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549378.name: Tape Echo
DLY:184549378.en: A magnetic tape-style echo with soft, slightly saturated repeats. Great for rockabilly, ambient and vintage leads. Mix, Time and Feedback set the echoes, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549378.pt: Eco estilo fita magnética, com repetições suaves e levemente saturadas. Ótimo para rockabilly, ambiências e solos vintage. Mix, Time e Feedback definem os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549387.name: Tube Echo
DLY:184549387.en: A tube-style echo with warm, rich repeats and a slight grit. Good for thickening leads and classic rock. Mix, Time and Feedback set the echoes, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549387.pt: Eco estilo valvulado, com repetições quentes e ricas e um leve grão. Bom para encorpar solos e rock clássico. Mix, Time e Feedback definem os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549405.name: Stereo BBD
DLY:184549405.en: A stereo bucket-brigade delay with dark, warm repeats and a wide image. Time and Time R% set the two sides, Spread the width, Feedback (±100), Mix and Level the blend, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549405.pt: Delay estéreo bucket-brigade, com repetições escuras e quentes e imagem larga. Time e Time R% definem os dois lados, Spread a largura, Feedback (±100), Mix e Level a mistura, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549380.name: Ping-Pong
DLY:184549380.en: A stereo ping-pong delay that bounces repeats between left and right. Great for wide, rhythmic leads. Mix, Time and Feedback set the echoes, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549380.pt: Delay estéreo ping-pong, que alterna as repetições entre esquerda e direita. Ótimo para solos largos e rítmicos. Mix, Time e Feedback definem os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549381.name: Slapback
DLY:184549381.en: A short slapback echo, the classic rockabilly and country doubling. Time runs from 20 to 300 ms, Mix and Feedback set the blend and repeats, Trail lets it ring out.
DLY:184549381.pt: Eco curto slapback, o clássico dobrado do rockabilly e do country. Time vai de 20 a 300 ms, Mix e Feedback definem a mistura e as repetições, e Trail deixa soar.

DLY:184549382.name: Sweep Echo
DLY:184549382.en: A delay whose repeats are swept by a filter for moving, vocal echoes. Sweep Depth and Sweep Rate set the motion, Mix, Time and Feedback the echoes, Sweep Sync, Time Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549382.pt: Delay cujas repetições são varridas por um filtro, para ecos que se movem e soam vocais. Sweep Depth e Sweep Rate definem o movimento, Mix, Time e Feedback os ecos, além de Sweep Sync, Time Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549385.name: Ring Echo
DLY:184549385.en: A delay fed through a ring modulator for metallic, sci-fi repeats. Dly Mix, Time and Feedback set the echoes, Ring Mix, Freq and Tone shape the ring, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549385.pt: Delay passado por um modulador em anel, para repetições metálicas e de ficção científica. Dly Mix, Time e Feedback definem os ecos, Ring Mix, Freq e Tone moldam o anel, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549388.name: Multi-Head
DLY:184549388.en: A multi-head tape echo: Mode picks one of 12 head combinations for rhythmic, cascading repeats. Mix, Time, Feedback and Tone shape the echoes, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549388.pt: Eco de fita com várias cabeças: Mode escolhe uma de 12 combinações de cabeças, para repetições rítmicas em cascata. Mix, Time, Feedback e Tone moldam os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549389.name: Classic Analog
DLY:184549389.en: Inspired by Boss DM-2. A classic bucket-brigade analog delay with dark, soft repeats that melt into the mix. Mix, Time and Feedback set the echoes, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549389.pt: Inspirado no Boss DM-2. Delay analógico bucket-brigade clássico, com repetições escuras e suaves que se misturam ao som. Mix, Time e Feedback definem os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549394.name: Rich Analog
DLY:184549394.en: Inspired by Maxon AD999. A long, clear analog delay with rich, musical repeats. Great for leads that need space. Mix, Time and Feedback set the echoes, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549394.pt: Inspirado no Maxon AD999. Delay analógico longo e claro, com repetições ricas e musicais. Ótimo para solos que pedem espaço. Mix, Time e Feedback definem os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549396.name: Rack Mod
DLY:184549396.en: A vintage rack-style delay with chorused, lush repeats. Great for 80s cleans and ambient leads. Mix, Time and Feedback set the echoes, Mod the movement, Tone the color, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549396.pt: Delay estilo rack vintage, com repetições exuberantes e com chorus. Ótimo para limpos dos anos 80 e solos ambientes. Mix, Time e Feedback definem os ecos, Mod o movimento, Tone a cor, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549414.name: Lo-Fi Echo
DLY:184549414.en: A lo-fi delay that degrades the repeats into gritty, crushed echoes. Crush and Bit set the damage, Mix, Time and Feedback (±100) the echoes, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549414.pt: Delay lo-fi que degrada as repetições em ecos sujos e esmagados. Crush e Bit definem o estrago, Mix, Time e Feedback (±100) os ecos, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549416.name: Reverse
DLY:184549416.en: A reverse delay that plays the repeats backwards, for swelling, psychedelic textures. Mix, Time and Feedback (±100) set the echoes, Level their volume, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549416.pt: Delay reverso, que toca as repetições ao contrário, para texturas psicodélicas que crescem. Mix, Time e Feedback (±100) definem os ecos, Level o volume deles, além de Sync e Trail.

DLY:184549379.name: Dual Delay
DLY:184549379.en: Two independent delay lines in one block, for rhythmic or wide stereo patterns. Mix, Time and Feedback for A and for B, A Sync and B Sync lock each to tempo, Trail lets them ring out.
DLY:184549379.pt: Duas linhas de delay independentes num só bloco, para padrões rítmicos ou estéreo largos. Mix, Time e Feedback para A e para B, A Sync e B Sync travam cada uma no tempo e Trail deixa soar.

DLY:184549420.name: Rack Digital
DLY:184549420.en: Inspired by TC Electronic 2290. A pristine studio rack digital delay with lush modulation. Mix, Time, Feedback, Mod Rate, Mod Depth, Phase Reverse, Low Cut, High Cut and Level, plus Sync and Trail.
DLY:184549420.pt: Inspirado no TC Electronic 2290. Delay digital de rack de estúdio, cristalino e com modulação exuberante. Mix, Time, Feedback, Mod Rate, Mod Depth, Phase Reverse, Low Cut, High Cut e Level, além de Sync e Trail.

RVB:201326603.name: Studio
RVB:201326603.en: A polished studio reverb with a smooth, modulated tail for vocals-like leads and clean parts. Mix, Pre Delay (up to 300 ms), Decay, Low Damp, Hi Damp and Mod, plus Trail.
RVB:201326603.pt: Reverb de estúdio refinado, com cauda suave e modulada, para solos e partes limpas. Mix, Pre Delay (até 300 ms), Decay, Low Damp, Hi Damp e Mod, além de Trail.

RVB:201326604.name: Club
RVB:201326604.en: The reverb of a small live club: short, warm and natural, adding life without washing out. Mix, Pre Delay, Decay, Low Damp, Hi Damp and Mod, plus Trail.
RVB:201326604.pt: O reverb de um pequeno clube ao vivo: curto, quente e natural, dá vida sem embolar. Mix, Pre Delay, Decay, Low Damp, Hi Damp e Mod, além de Trail.

RVB:201326592.name: Room
RVB:201326592.en: A small room reverb that adds natural space without blurring the tone. Good on rhythm parts. Mix, Pre Delay and Decay set the amount and length, Trail lets it ring out.
RVB:201326592.pt: Reverb de sala pequena, que dá espaço natural sem borrar o timbre. Bom em bases. Mix, Pre Delay e Decay definem quantidade e duração, e Trail deixa a cauda soar.

RVB:201326593.name: Hall
RVB:201326593.en: A concert-hall reverb with a large, open space and a long, even tail. Great for leads and ballads. Mix, Pre Delay and Decay set the amount and length, plus Trail.
RVB:201326593.pt: Reverb de sala de concerto, com espaço grande e aberto e cauda longa e uniforme. Ótimo para solos e baladas. Mix, Pre Delay e Decay definem quantidade e duração, além de Trail.

RVB:201326594.name: Church
RVB:201326594.en: A church reverb with a huge, high-ceilinged space and a very long tail. Great for ambient swells and slow leads. Mix, Pre Delay and Decay, plus Trail.
RVB:201326594.pt: Reverb de igreja, com espaço enorme de pé-direito alto e cauda muito longa. Ótimo para ambiências e solos lentos. Mix, Pre Delay e Decay, além de Trail.

RVB:201326595.name: Plate
RVB:201326595.en: A studio plate reverb: dense, smooth and bright, sitting well on leads and cleans. Mix and Decay set the amount and length, High Damp tames the top, Trail lets it ring out.
RVB:201326595.pt: Reverb de placa de estúdio: denso, suave e brilhante, assenta bem em solos e limpos. Mix e Decay definem quantidade e duração, High Damp doma os agudos e Trail deixa soar.

RVB:201326596.name: Spring
RVB:201326596.en: A vintage amp spring reverb with a bouncy, splashy drip. Perfect for surf, rockabilly and clean twang. Mix and Decay set the amount and length, Tone the brightness, plus Trail.
RVB:201326596.pt: Reverb de mola de amp vintage, com aquele respingo saltitante. Perfeito para surf, rockabilly e twang limpo. Mix e Decay definem quantidade e duração, Tone o brilho, além de Trail.

RVB:201326598.name: Airy Wash
RVB:201326598.en: A simple, airy ambient reverb with a bright, open tail, quick to dial in. Mix and Decay are the only controls, Trail lets the tail ring out.
RVB:201326598.pt: Reverb ambiente simples e arejado, com cauda brilhante e aberta, rápido de ajustar. Mix e Decay são os únicos controles, e Trail deixa a cauda soar.

RVB:201326599.name: Deep Wash
RVB:201326599.en: A simple, deep ambient reverb with a dark, enveloping tail for slow, moody parts. Mix and Decay are the only controls, Trail lets the tail ring out.
RVB:201326599.pt: Reverb ambiente simples e profundo, com cauda escura e envolvente para partes lentas e climáticas. Mix e Decay são os únicos controles, e Trail deixa a cauda soar.

RVB:201326600.name: Mod Space
RVB:201326600.en: A sweet modulated reverb with a gently moving tail, for dreamy cleans. Mix, Pre Delay and Decay set the space, Lo End and Hi End (±50) shape its tone, plus Trail.
RVB:201326600.pt: Reverb modulado e doce, com cauda que se move suavemente, para limpos sonhadores. Mix, Pre Delay e Decay definem o espaço, Lo End e Hi End (±50) moldam o timbre, além de Trail.

RVB:201326601.name: Shimmer
RVB:201326601.en: A shimmer reverb that adds a glowing, pitched-up halo to the tail. Made for ambient pads and post-rock. Mix, Pre Delay and Decay, Lo End and Hi End (±50), plus Trail.
RVB:201326601.pt: Reverb shimmer, que acrescenta à cauda um halo brilhante afinado para cima. Feito para pads ambientes e post-rock. Mix, Pre Delay e Decay, Lo End e Hi End (±50), além de Trail.

RVB:201326613.name: Ambient
RVB:201326613.en: A hazy, cloud-like ambient reverb with a soft, modulated wash. Great for swells and textures. Mix, Pre Delay (up to 300 ms), Decay, Low Damp, Hi Damp and Mod, plus Trail.
RVB:201326613.pt: Reverb ambiente enevoado, como uma nuvem, com lavagem suave e modulada. Ótimo para swells e texturas. Mix, Pre Delay (até 300 ms), Decay, Low Damp, Hi Damp e Mod, além de Trail.

FXLOOP:100663296.name: FX Loop
FXLOOP:100663296.en: An effects loop that sends your signal to external pedals and brings it back. Send Level and Return Level set the gain, Mix blends the processed sound.
FXLOOP:100663296.pt: Loop de efeitos que envia o sinal para pedais externos e o traz de volta. Send Level e Return Level ajustam o ganho e Mix mistura o som processado.

FXSND:100663297.name: FX Send
FXSND:100663297.en: The send half of a split effects loop, feeding your signal to external gear. Send Level sets how hot the signal leaves.
FXSND:100663297.pt: A metade de envio de um loop de efeitos dividido, alimentando equipamentos externos. Send Level define a força do sinal que sai.

FXRTN:100663298.name: FX Return
FXRTN:100663298.en: The return half of a split effects loop, bringing external gear back in. Return Level sets the incoming volume, Mix blends it with the dry signal.
FXRTN:100663298.pt: A metade de retorno de um loop de efeitos dividido, trazendo o equipamento externo de volta. Return Level define o volume de entrada e Mix mistura com o sinal seco.

VOL:100663299.name: Volume
VOL:100663299.en: A plain volume control for setting level in the chain or for use with an expression pedal. Volume sets the output level.
VOL:100663299.pt: Controle de volume simples para ajustar o nível na cadeia ou usar com pedal de expressão. Volume define o nível de saída.
